comparison.objective: Candidate removes a locked terminal; record seats a strain-wave flexspline in a robot-joint housing until its teeth mesh.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade-under-tab insertion and simultaneous wire-tool pull versus coaxial insertion with phase search, controlled rotation, and anti-cocking force control.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits without connector damage or neighbor release versus collar seated flat, teeth meshed, pose tolerances met, and part released.
comparison.reason: This is a close industrial manipulation comparison, but it tests rotational tooth meshing rather than compliant latch release and extraction.
